meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个 AI 互相挑刺,把计划打磨到经得起质疑再定稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手前想把方案交给多方挑刺、避免漏判错判
copy.tagline_en: Have multiple AIs critique your plan from opposing angles before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a plan stress-tested by opposing viewpoints before you commit

howto.what: 启动一个 5 人对抗规划团队,成员互相攻击彼此的发现;只有扛住攻击的结论被保留,再交给专门的规划者写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当你要求做 hyperplan、对抗式或交叉批判式规划,或规划需要最高严谨度时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperplan 规划这次重构。
say.note: 先启动 5 人对抗团队,再由规划者成文。

say.text: 用对抗式规划评审我的发布计划,尽量挑毛病。
say.note: 成员会交叉批判,只有站得住的部分进入计划。

say.text: 给我一份交叉批判的计划:上线新的计费模块。
say.note: 进入前会先报 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!

howto.what_en: Spawns a 5-member adversarial planning team whose members attack each other's findings; only the defensible insights survive and are handed to a dedicated planner that writes the formal plan.
howto.when_en: Use when planning needs maximum rigor, or when the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial / cross-critique plan.

say_en.text: Run a hyperplan for this refactor.
say_en.note: Starts the 5-member team, then a planner writes it up.

say_en.text: Adversarially review my release plan and attack the weak parts.
say_en.note: Members cross-critique before anything is formalized.

say_en.text: Give me a cross-critique plan for launching a new billing module.
say_en.note: It first announces HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!
